what: Dark-music firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: 21 genres and 210 ready-made pieces, from dark techno and cinema to dark ambient, witch house and dungeon synth. Pick a piece and it plays, then Wander slowly evolves it on its own while Auto FX and Drum Vary keep the sound and the beat moving. Play it live with the keys, an arp with its own dark voices, Hold and Dice, or write patterns in the step editor, even while the arp runs. Everything is built to be easy to use: bigger, easier-to-read text, a clean redesigned screen, brand new visuals, completely simplified settings, plain-language help on every menu, and a SEL shortcut menu that lists every control.
